DRAFT: NOT AN APPROVAL. This is the approval a human would grant for the static-only nested refinement study, prepared for review. The driver reads only STUDY-APPROVAL.json, and this file authorises nothing. The study is PREPARED, NOT APPROVED, NOT EXECUTED.
how_to_grant_it: A human who approves writes experiments/static-refinement-study/STUDY-APPROVAL.json. It contains every field below except DRAFT and how_to_grant_it. source_commit is replaced by the full SHA of the commit the human reviewed, which must be the checkout's HEAD at execution. not_before_utc and not_after_utc are replaced by ISO-8601 UTC times at most 7 days apart. Every other field is copied unchanged. The driver refuses if any digest, the environment, the invocation (its text here, and the invocation it measures: working directory, argv, the parent timeout command, the .venv interpreter, no -O, bytecode caches bypassed), the budget, the checkout path, HEAD or the time differs from what is written there. A change to the pre-declaration, the mesh or any executed code file after review therefore voids the approval. Running it spends the one attempt before any solve: the driver creates <git common directory>/qmhp-attempts/STATIC-REFINEMENT-STUDY.json and ATTEMPT-SPENT.json exclusively, and renames STUDY-APPROVAL.json to STUDY-APPROVAL.consumed.json. After the run, the record, ATTEMPT-SPENT.json and STUDY-APPROVAL.consumed.json are committed together; the git-common-directory entry stays where it is and is never committed.
authorises: one execution of the static-only nested refinement study
run_label: static-only nested refinement study, attempt 1 of 1
source_commit: <the full SHA of the reviewed commit; must equal HEAD at execution>
not_after_utc: <ISO-8601 UTC, at most 7 days after not_before_utc>

environment.rule: The versions the solver verification, preflight and dry run ran on. execute() refuses before spending the attempt if any differs, if a thread variable is not '1', if np.longdouble is not wider than float64 (x86-64 80-bit), or if long-double ARITHMETIC fails the probe (an x87 precision-control word set to 53 bits passes the storage-format check but fails the probe). The repository pins Python only to '3.11' (.python-version, CI), so a rebuild of .venv with another patch release makes the study refuse with nothing spent; the study then needs a new pre-declaration and approval. Push CI runs the tests on its own interpreter and is not the verified environment.

invocation: from the repository root, locally, no workflow, no network: env OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 timeout --signal=KILL 3660 .venv/bin/python experiments/static-refinement-study/study_driver.py

budget.retry: none. A failure, a refusal after the record exists, a timeout, a budget limit or an integrity failure is the recorded outcome.

after_the_run_before_the_environment_is_: Mandatory, whatever the outcome: follow predeclaration.json one_attempt.preservation_before_the_environment_is_discarded. In short: commit and push the record with ATTEMPT-SPENT.json and STUDY-APPROVAL.consumed.json; if no record directory exists (a ledger-only failure, exit 3 'no record could be created'), first copy <git common directory>/qmhp-attempts/STATIC-REFINEMENT-STUDY.json byte for byte to experiments/static-refinement-study/ATTEMPT-LEDGER-NOTE.json and commit it with them; confirm the push before the environment is discarded, and never discard it with that evidence only inside it.
does_not_authorise: a second attempt, whatever the first one's outcome (any class, a failure, a timeout, a budget limit or an integrity failure)
running from another checkout, another commit or outside the validity window
removing or editing ATTEMPT-SPENT.json, the git-common-directory ledger entry, STUDY-APPROVAL.consumed.json or the record
writing a new STUDY-APPROVAL.json after this one has been consumed, in this checkout or in any other clone
a level 3, another mesh, another refinement method, or any change to the solver settings, tolerances, windows or rules
reading the consistency window more widely than declared, or reading S'_h as H_h unless the level-0 check is CONSISTENT
combining C_h, C'_h, S_h, S'_h or delta_h with g, f_R or any Route A output
any Palace solve or workflow dispatch
any change to the withdrawn paired test or to the executed static-anchor record
